d: We have an urgent requirement for Network Engineer (CCNP Cerified) in experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM)-Preffered for our client based in Bahrain

designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructures---Muststrong expertise in Cisco networking technologies and a proven ability to ensure high network availability, performance, and security. --MustExperience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) .--MustCCNP Certification-Mandatory Job SummaryWe are seeking a skilled and motivated Network Engineer with CCNP certification and 3-4 years of hands-on experience in designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructures. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Cisco networking technologies and a proven ability to ensure high network availability, performance, and security. Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) .Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center network environments.
Monitor network performance and proactively identify and resolve issues to minimize downtime.
Configure and troubleshoot Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless solutions.
Perform network capacity planning, upgrades, and optimization activities.
Ensure network security by implementing and maintaining security policies and best practices.
Support network monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on infrastructure projects and network-related initiatives.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures.
Provide technical support and participate in on-call rotations when required.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
3-4 years of experience in network administration, implementation, and support.
Experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus platforms.
Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM).
Exposure to Network Access Control (NAC), AAA, and endpoint security solutions.
Knowledge of SD-WAN, Wireless Networking, and network automation tools is a plus

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Revenue professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.

You must be computer literate with excellent communication skills, written and oral proficiency in English, while additional language skills are an asset.
Customer Focused and with an extremely proactive personality and a courteous, dynamic and approachable character.

You will work effectively with professionalism and establish effective relationships with internal and external customers. You work independently within a structured environment while possessing the following additional competencies

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
q: 5+ years in internet product/growth roles, with at least 2 years at a crypto exchange or Web3 platform
